neighbours.label: copula ' is'/' was' after an abstract noun-phrase subject, before an evaluative predicate (the silence is deafening)
fire: After the scandal, the outrage among voters was immediate.
Many experts agree that her courage is remarkable.
In this town, the loneliness of winter is hard to bear.
Looking back, his generosity was the reason they stayed.
To be honest, the timing of the decision is suspicious.
Most readers felt the ending of the novel was disappointing.
For the farmers, the drought this year is a disaster.
Clearly the confusion over the rules was understandable.
quiet: After the scandal, the voters marched to city hall.
Many experts agree that she climbed the mountain alone.
In this town, people stay indoors through the winter.
Looking back, he gave them money so they stayed.
To be honest, the committee announced the decision late.
Most readers finished the novel in a single weekend.
For the farmers, the rains arrived late this year.
Clearly the players argued over the rules for an hour.

notes: card: ' is' x12, ' was' x5 after abstract subjects (the silence is deafening); probe: 0.48-0.54 on such copulas, 0.003 on a plain action sentence.
